name: hampel
expr: [y,i,xmed,xsig] = hampel(x); ny = double(numel(y)); di = sum(double(i)); i3 = double(i(3)); m1 = xmed(1); m5 = xmed(5); s1 = xsig(1); [y2,i2,m2,s2] = hampel(x2, 2); di2 = sum(double(i2)); y2a = y2(4); y2b = y2(8); s2d = s2(4);
comment: Sig: [y,i,xmedian,xsigma] = hampel(x[,k[,nsigma]]). DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31: only the 1st output (filtered signal) was implemented; the documented i (logical outlier mask), xmedian (local window median), and xsigma (local 1.4826*MAD estimate) outputs were missing. Also switched the MAD->sigma factor from the loose 1.4826 to the MATLAB-exact 1/norminv(0.75)=1.482602218505602 (was off by ~1e-5, now xsigma matches to 1e-12). x=[1 2 100 3 4] default k=3,nsigma=3 -> y=[1 2 3 3 4], i=[0 0 1 0 0], xmed=[2.5 3 3 3 3.5], xsig=1.482602218505602. x2 k=2 -> 2 outliers flagged, s2(4)=2.965204437011. Matrix form deferred. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
